text: Damn, if she treats him like this on his birthday, what happens on the regular days? Yeah, we got it, it is your birthday, man! Is this the only thing that bothers you in this situation? Your girlfriend is treating you worse than a doormat, and you keep repeating that it's your birthday. Stop the car, kick her out, and never talk to her again. Oh, the classic, you are so fragile and insecure when your girl is talking to other men. Guys, if your girl talks to other men behind your back, you don't have to tell her that. She knows what she is doing. This is basically emotional cheating. If she does it, leave her. Man, your boundaries are practically non-existent. Your self-respect is hiding somewhere deep inside. Your bros told you bye-bye. What boundaries are you talking about here? You know what amazes me here is how much confidence and self-worth this woman has. She is the villain in this situation, emotionally and maybe physically cheat on him, insults and verbally abuses him, constantly puts him down. But the confidence, she is sure that she deserves better. And she has no doubt she can find a better man. If only men had a freaking share of women's confidence. Damn, 4 years, you have been with this girl for 4 years, how? How could you endure all of that? Man, where is at least some self-love in some men? They are ready to endure any humiliations just to have a girl next to them. Okay, finally, something that he should have done long ago. Man, I really hope that this was his last straw. He has been with her for 4 years and this is how she treats him on his birthday. Guys, if your relationship have a tense of what is happening here, break up and never look back. You don't need to argue, to figure out stuff. Just leave. Once again, self-respect comes first. If you do not respect yourself, other people will not either.
